test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: maths
question: Average age of 7 students of a class is 28 years. Average age of first three students is 30 years. Age of fourth student is 4 years less than the age of fifth student. Ages of last two students is same and is 5 more than the average age of first three students. What is the average age of fourth and fifth student ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of ages = 7 × 28 = 196 years.

Sum of first 3 students = 3 × 30 = 90 years.

Age of each of the last 2 students = 30 + 5 = 35 years.

Sum of last 2 students = 2 × 35 = 70 years.

Remaining sum for 4th and 5th student = 196 − (90 + 70) = 36 years.

Average of 4th and 5th student = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 7

Average age of 7 students = 28 years

Average age of first 3 students = 30 years

Ages of last 2 students = Average of first 3 + 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2bd8732919ee033febde7eb5d682e6578fed1407ccb9e22f8482564df0e36a4.png] 

**Formula:** Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

⇒ Total age of 7 students = 7 × 28 = 196 years

⇒ Sum of first 3 students = 3 × 30 = 90 years

⇒ Age of 6th student = Age of 7th student = 30 + 5 = 35 years

⇒ Sum of ages of 6th and 7th student = 35 + 35 = 70 years

⇒ Let age of 5th student be x. Then age of 4th student = x − 4

⇒ Sum of 4th and 5th student = (x − 4) + x = 2x − 4

⇒ 196 = 90 + (2x − 4) + 70

⇒ 196 = 160 + 2x − 4

⇒ 196 = 156 + 2x

⇒ 2x = 196 − 156 = 40

⇒ x = 20 years (Age of 5th student)

⇒ Age of 4th student = 20 − 4 = 16 years

⇒ Average of 4th and 5th student = (16 + 20) ÷ 2 = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 years

**∴ The correct answer is 18 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When two or more groups with different averages are combined, the overall average = (n₁×a₁ + n₂×a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Sum and Difference Property

If the sum of two numbers is S and their difference is D, then the average of the two numbers is simply S ÷ 2, regardless of the difference.

Effect of Constant Change

If every observation in a set is increased or decreased by a constant k, the average of the set also increases or decreases by k.</p
